description: This file declares functions for managing network bridges, including initialization, shutdown, and iteration over ports and bridges. It contains platform-specific implementations and defines interface functions for external use.

methods.name: int br_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the bridge subsystem. Function is platform-dependent.

methods.name: void br_shutdown(void)
methods.description: Shuts down the bridge subsystem. Function is platform-dependent.

methods.name: int br_foreach_port(const char * brname,int (* iterator)(const char * br,const char * port,void * arg),void * arg)
methods.description: Iterates over each port in a bridge, calling the provided iterator function for each port.

methods.name: int br_foreach_bridge(int (* iterator)(const char *,void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Iterates over each bridge, invoking the iterator function for each.
